context: Two teens watch a sports event
purpose: Teach: 岡崎/星野/ウィリアム/デイヴィッド/ゲイツ/蘭/是非とも/アタック

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 岡崎選手、今日も先発だ。
lines.style: Quick, bright observation shared in the moment. Slight uptick on the realization. Cool but engaged — the kind of casual notice you make when you're already invested.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 星野コーチの戦術、相手チームを翻弄してる。
lines.en: Coach Hoshino's tactics are totally throwing them off.
lines.style: Leaning forward slightly. Animated delivery with sharp precision on the key word. Eyes bright with the pleasure of seeing a strategy work. Engaged commentary, not lecture.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 相手のキャプテン、ウィリアム選手、強いよな。
lines.en: Their captain, William — he's solid, though.
lines.style: Acknowledging tone. Respectful pause before the name. Honest assessment without defensiveness. Matter-of-fact rhythm, like stating something obvious to someone who'd understand.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: デイヴィッド選手、ベンチから指示を送ってる。
lines.en: David's calling plays from the bench.
lines.style: Observant, slightly probing. Light curiosity in the delivery — noticing what others might miss. Steady pace. Watching more than commenting.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 本場の解説、ゲイツ氏が務めてるって、ラジオで。
lines.en: Mr. Gates is doing the live commentary — heard it on the radio.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before the detail. Impressed by the authenticity of it. Measured delivery — sharing something he noticed and found worth mentioning. Slight fade on the source.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 休憩で、蘭の花が飾られたVIP席、見える?
lines.en: During the break — can you see the VIP section with the orchids?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, turning slightly toward Riku. Soft wonder in the question. Not performative — just noticing something pretty and wanting to share it. Lightly expectant.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 是非とも、後半は逆転してほしい。
lines.en: I really want them to pull off a second-half comeback.
lines.style: Earnest and direct. Slight lean into the want. Quiet conviction underneath — this matters more than casual sports chat. Steady eye contact level in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ラスト10分、アタックを集中させようよ。
lines.en: Last ten minutes — let's concentrate the attack.
lines.style: Energized closing statement. Sharp, tactical focus. Rallying tone without being bossy. Quick and bright, like a natural conclusion to the thread. Rising slightly at the end.
